name: Metamagic Wand Grip
body:
Price 6,000 gp; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 6; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This light copper clasp can be wrapped around the grip of a wand and the copper is etched with runes. A metamagic wand grip functions three times per day and the runes on it glow when activated. Attaching the metamagic wand grip to a wand is a standard action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

If the wearer of the belt has a familiar, animal companion, or special mount it can fit into one of the pockets regardless of its size. While within a pocket the creature requires no air, food, or water.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, carry companion, secret chest
